reviews.body: Thank you so much for contributing this fix! I've added a few small comments as well as opened a draft PR with some changes on top of yours to address a similar unused property and add documentation (https://github.com/aws/aws-advanced-nodejs-wrapper/pull/727). I would really appreciate it if you would take a look at the docs there if you have the time :)

review_comments.body: We should add the same check here to avoid looping on a role check
Same comment let's check VERIFY_OPENED_CONNECTION_ROLE here to avoid looping on a role check
nit: adding a helper for  `WrapperProperties.VERIFY_OPENED_CONNECTION_ROLE.get(props) !== "none"` would increase readability

Done in 1061754: the two identifyConnection() paths now skip the role check when verifyOpenedConnectionType is none, and the condition moved into a shouldVerifyRole() helper used at all four sites. Added a test for the topology-mismatch case (writer and reader).


This comment was drafted with Claude Code.
